title: 13 · ganga · The River in His Hair
lines: A river once fell from heaven hard enough to crack the earth.
Sixty thousand princes had been burned to ash by a sage's glance.
Only one river could free their souls.
And she lived in the sky.
stood on one leg and prayed. For years.
I will fall with all my weight.
"I will fall with all my weight.
I will sweep even Shiva down to the underworld.
I will sweep even Shiva down to the underworld."
So Bhagiratha prayed again. To Shiva this time.
Lost in his hair. For years. Until all her pride was gone.
Then he let her out in seven gentle streams.
And she flowed over the ashes, and the princes rose.
Great force needs a quiet place to land. Be that place. That is sadhana.
